Please make sure to update your records accordingly.

Dalton Street 123
New York, NY 10001
USA

Best regards,
Your landlord

files.landlord-notices.txt:
Dear tenant,
Please note that starting from next month, the rent will be 
increased by 100.00. Please make sure to adjust your standing
order accordingly.
Best regards,
Your landlord
